mapper.sql: p.id, p.account_id, p.service_name, p.service_flag, p.internal_remark, p.version, a.nickname, a.phone_cipher, a.phone_verified_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vi_vehicle v WHERE v.owner_account_id = a.id AND v.deleted_at IS NULL) AS vehicle_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vi_order o WHERE o.owner_account_id = a.id ) AS order_count, (SELECT MAX(o.created_at) FROM vi_order o WHERE o.owner_account_id = a.id ) AS last_service_at

sql.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vi_order o WHERE o.owner_account_id = a.id AND o.dept_id IN #{d})
AND (a.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.service_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: SELECT FROM vi_owner_profile p JOIN vi_account a ON a.id = p.account_id WHERE 1 = 1 ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vi_owner_profile p JOIN vi_account a ON a.id = p.account_id WHERE 1 = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vi_vehicle WHERE owner_account_id = #{accountId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.fulfillment_status, o.cancel_status, o.custody_type, o.pickup_starts_at, o.pickup_ends_at, o.returned_at, o.version, o.vehicle_snapshot, o.station_id, s.name AS station_name, s.address AS station_address, s.lng, s.lat, (SELECT pay.status FROM vi_payment_order pay WHERE pay.order_id = o.id ORDER BY pay.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS payment_status FROM vi_order o JOIN vi_station s ON s.id = o.station_id WHERE o.owner_account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY o.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vi_order o WHERE o.owner_account_id = #{accountId}
